exhaustive derivation graphs up to n = 17 (EXP-C04-03)
meta.falsification: Any n <= 21 where the maximum over words differs from the formula, or any word whose derivation length differs from the configuration formula.
meta.hypothesis: H-C04-L: writing w = a^x0 b a^x1 ... b a^xm, each step is the carry 2[k] -> [k+1] (k < m) with level m a sink; hence D(n) = max over m of (n - m) - ceil((n - m)/2^m), i.e. n - D(n) = min_m (m + ceil((n-m)/2^m)) = log2(n) + O(1). Predicted first terms where D stalls: n = 4, 7, 12, 21, 38, ...
meta.methodology: (1) Exhaustive derivation graphs for n <= 14 (independent of the reduction). (2) For n <= 21, one leftmost derivation per word (valid by random descent) over all 2^n words. (3) Per-word check of the configuration formula D(w) = T - s2(V mod 2^m) - floor(V/2^m).
meta.question: Why does the derivational complexity of aab -> ba admit no linear recurrence?
meta.title: The rule aab -> ba is a truncated binary exchange system: D(n) = max_m (n-m) - ceil((n-m)/2^m)
